profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with extensive experience in both systems and applications programming including prototyping, customer engineering, product development, sustaining and support. Well versed in agile and scrum methodologies from design and specification, development and maintenance, through quality assurance and customer support. Can provide technical direction and mentoring to staff.

Specialties: Solaris, Linux and Windows operating systems

Java, C/C++, Unix Shell, Batch file, PowerShell, VBScript, XML, JSON, Python, Perl, JavaScript, HTML programming/scripting languages

Oracle, MySQL, JavaDB and NoSQL databases

Solaris Technologies such as SMF, ZFS, Containers/Zones, DTrace, IPS, JumpStart, Flash, Live Upgrade, SVR4 Packaging and patching

Java Technologies such as JPA, JSP, Servlet, JAAS, JavaMail, JDBC, and Web Start

Source control management systems such as Git, Mercurial, Subversion, CVS, and Teamware

Storage data services such as NFS, SMB, iSCSI, FibreChannel

Oracle technology such as Database, Grid Infrastructure, ASM, RAC, RAC One Node, and Single Instance

Oracle engineered systems such as Exadata, ODA, and SPARC SuperCluster

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of the PCA Compute C@C Development organization, member of the automation team responsible for developing, implementing, and supporting the automation platform utilized for automating all test cases for the Oracle Private Cloud Appliance. This team is also responsible for providing the automated testing framework (with high quality) to stress the quality of tests, provide more efficiency and mainly more productivity for the functional tests, regression tests, and system testing teams within Solaris Cluster, ZFS Storage, and Oracle Linux Virtualization organizations.

Designing and developing complex tests cases to be utilized with the Oracle Flash Storage, and as part of the automation cycles and routine to vigorously test the best storage for the cloud, Oracle Flash Storage Systems.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Design, develop, troubleshoot and debug software programs for databases, applications, tools, networks etc. Develop plugins and integration components in the areas of enterprise monitoring/ management software, backup software, virtualization storage offloads and database appliance backups.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Programmer and software designer in Open Storage Systems Group. Responsible for the creation of plug-in components that comply with application APIs and SDKs and communicate with a Oracle ZS Storage Appliance across a variety of protocols.

Conceived, designed and wrote the initial implementation of add-on host software for the Oracle ZS Storage Appliance that DBAs can use to backup, restore and clone Oracle databases and Oracle database backups stored on the storage appliance using ZFS snapshot technology. The software orchestrates operations between the storage, compute and database systems from a central management node giving the DBA the power to perform storage and server administration seamlessly as a part of performing their common data protection and replication tasks. This allowed DBAs to quickly provision and create clone databases and provided database lifecycle management for devops. Led the growing development team (eventually 7 engineers) for 3 marketing releases and 6 micro releases over the course of 4 years. Handled 3rd party library usage and security reviews of the product. Provided key product support to large enterprise customers who used the product in their devops production environment with Oracle engineered systems.

https://www.oracle.com/storage/nas/snap/index.html

Created private 12c Oracle home component  that provides the snapshot copy option for pluggable database cloning when Oracle ZS Storage Appliance is used. This allows for the creation of PDB clones that are space and time efficient; they can be created instantaneously and share common storage blocks with their source allowing clone provisioning to be done up to 90% faster than before.

http://www.oracle.com/technetwork/articles/servers-storage-admin/multitenant-on-sparc-solaris-2016889.html#6

positions.title: Software Contractor
positions.description: On assignment at Oracle Corporation, developing and enhancing software installation and configuration management features of the Oracle Hardware Management Pack product. Management Pack is used for single server management of Solaris, Linux and Windows hosts including lights out management, firmware updates, RAID configuration and BIOS configuration.

positions.title: Staff Engineer, Software
positions.description: Designed, implemented, tested and created tooling for software products used primarily by system administrators and platform builders. Worked on a large variety of development projects over the course of almost 15 years from device drivers, zero admin systems, java runtime environments, OS provisioning, installation and patching, and RAID and SAS switched array management. Intimately familiar with the Solaris operating system and the Java programming language and runtime environment. Strong ability to troubleshoot and debug software misconfigurations and defects. Experienced in resolving test and customer issues in a timely manner and to everyone's satisfaction.

positions.title: Programmer II
positions.description: Developed and maintained information and engineering systems
